subject: Andrews Middle School Incoming Sixth Grade Orientation
overview: Andrews Middle School faculty, staff, and student leaders held a virtual open house to welcome incoming sixth graders and present information on school culture, clubs, and academic programs.

items.title: Faculty and Staff Welcome
items.summary: Andrews Middle School faculty and staff greeted incoming sixth graders and offered guidance on transitioning to middle school.

items.title: National Junior Honor Society Advice
items.summary: National Junior Honor Society members shared tips for academic success, homework management, and staying organized.

items.title: Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility (CCSR)
items.summary: Ms. Van Doyen and student members introduced the CCSR club and described community service projects completed by students.

items.title: Seventh Grade Social Studies and Global Scholars
items.summary: Mr. Zizzo outlined seventh-grade social studies topics and highlighted the Global Scholars international exchange program.

items.title: Music Department Welcome
items.summary: Music teacher Ms. Grant welcomed future students and shared a snippet of the Andrews Middle School anthem.
